control.loop: L0, sole loop; phase is usize and receives a fresh iteration binding.
control.condition: I0, sole IF: phase == usize(4), producing bool.
control.C0: True arm: continue(usize(19)); targets L0. Positive C path has no T reads/writes, helper calls, loans, extra phase computation or nested conditions.
control.B0: False arm: genuine write loan/helper replace at original@checkpoint, then break prior; targets L0.
control.complete_edges: C0 and B0 are all lexical Continue/BREAK sites in every file. The valid normal source has both reachable paths and no loop fall-through or RETURN. The immediate control may have C0 proven unreachable from source semantics.
control.induction: Entry plus every reachable C0 successor must be subsumed by a sound inductive H. Fresh phase binding is distinct from captured T original/package identity. First-iteration-only facts must not be reused without that obligation.
control.limit: Selected finite counts follow from 19 != 4, not from a general termination assumption. Finite traces do not prove all-H induction or general termination.
